answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to lock a refundable stake bonded to a hardware-attested key before it can transact. Honest agents reclaim their bond, but a sybil swarm must fund each clone separately, so the cost rises like an incoming tide against the attacker. Peer attestations build a crystal-clear reputation ledger, and any cluster of fresh identities spun up at once reads like a dim nebula of unbonded nodes the network discounts at settlement.
